takes.situation: Zhou is busy and burned before: makes the Fixer spell out a 'small favour'.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Not now. The Councillor's out at the chime, and I drive.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: A lean month, I hear. We'd pay for a small favour.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Last small favour got my pay card stamped short. Say it exactly.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: The Councillor gets in at the chime. We don't want him home.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Who's we? Don't tell me, then nobody can ask me.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Drive him round to the service bay, east yard, and wait there.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: A couple of minutes, then I drive on. Getting him out's yours.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Seventy thousand, and it's paid. We'll be at the service bay.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: I won't look. Anyone hanging about watching here, I can send off.

learned: Zhou drives Vale to service bay.

takes.situation: The money moved before Zhou agreed: Zhou objects, the Fixer's kindness shows its steel.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Seventy thousand, paid before I've said yes. That's not how I work.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It's been a lean month. We didn't want to keep you waiting.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: I won't ask who's we. What I don't know can't cost me.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Then just the job. The Councillor gets in at the chime.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: That's on my stamped route card. What's seventy thousand buy, exactly?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: You don't drive him home. Service bay, round the back, east yard.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: And wait? A couple of minutes, then I drive on, whoever's late.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We won't be late, Zhou. We take him from the back seat.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Not in my mirror. Anyone watching this bay, I'll send them off.

learned: Paid Zhou waits briefly with Vale.

takes.situation: Opens mid-talk with Zhou already interested: the fight is over how long the wait lasts.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: You said money. My pay's come down the tube light all month.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We've paid seventy thousand already, for one short drive with the Councillor.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: I won't ask who's we. Asking's never once raised my wage.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: He gets in at the chime. Service bay, not home, and wait.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: How long, exactly? I've been paid for 'not long' before.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Until we've got him out of the back seat. Not long.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: A couple of minutes, then I drive on. Seventy doesn't buy longer.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We'll be at the east yard service bay. You won't see it.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: See that I don't. Anyone watching here, I can send them off.

learned: Zhou waits a couple of minutes.
